opus.problem: All 7 clues fit the common synonym 'grave' just as well as 'tomb' (a dead man in Elisha's grave, Lazarus four days in the grave, David's grave still with us). The clues cannot tell the two apart, so a baker who types 'grave' would be marked wrong. Either add 'grave' (and maybe 'sepulchre') to the accepted answers, or change a clue so that only 'tomb' fits.
